root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause was agents lacking schema path references, preventing self-validation at write time. All 6 agent definition files now contain explicit schema path references in step 4 of their save checklist, immediately before the save.py call. This covers the primary re-invocation paths (Steps 15 and 20 re-invocations). Step 8 first-invocation coverage is partial (meals-agent only via inline prompt; other 5 via agent definition file which is also loaded on Task invocation). The referenced schema files all exist on disk. The fix substantially addresses the root cause for all agent re-invocation scenarios.

all_findings.issue: AC1 partially unmet: plan.md Step 8 contains an inline schema validation instruction only for meals-agent. The 5 remaining agents (accommodation, attractions, entertainment, shopping, transportation) in Step 8 are invoked by agent name reference only without inline prompt blocks, so they have no inline schema validation instruction at Step 8 first-invocation. Coverage is provided via agent .md files (which are loaded on Task invocation), but the BA spec AC1 requires the instruction in each of the 6 Step 8 prompt blocks.
all_findings.recommendation: Add inline prompt blocks for all 5 remaining agents in plan.md Step 8 (following the same pattern as meals-agent), each containing 'Validate output against schema: /root/travel-planner/schemas/{agent}.schema.json before saving.' immediately before their Save to: line. This is also flagged in the dev report recommendations section.
